_comment: The ?join= link's shape, as a checked fact rather than a convention (#46).
It is written in THREE places -- cmd/vtt/joinlink.go's show and rotate, and
client/src/view/dm.ts -- and read in ONE, client/src/app.ts. Nothing tied
them together, so renaming the parameter left `vtt join-link show` printing
a dead link with every gate green.
INVISIBLE TO BOTH MUTATION GATES, which is why a fixture rather than a test
alone: gremlins does not mutate string literals, and Stryker cannot see the
Go side at all. It spans two languages, so a shared constant is not
available either -- this file is the nearest thing to one.
Asserted by cmd/vtt/cli_test.go (the CLI writers) and client/test/
join-url-format.test.ts (the browser writer AND the reader). Change the
parameter here and all four sites fail at once, which is the whole point.
